comments: Searches IP access control lists with the specified criteria and pagination.

params.name: name
comments: (Optional) The name of the IP access control list to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.

params.name: numberOfResults
comments: (Optional) The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

params.name: orderBy
comments: (Optional) The field to order the results by. Supported values: id, insertInstant, lastUpdateInstant, name.

params.name: startRow
comments: (Optional) The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.
